name: Crossed Wires
hint: Your plate opens their gate. Their plate opens yours.
why4: Each pair can only pass while the other pair holds a 2-plate for it; a pair of one cannot hold a plate.
solution: Downstairs, P3 and P4 jump the 2-wide pit at x=9-10 and wait at gate A (x=20).
Upstairs, P1 and P2 stand on the plate at x=16-17: gate A opens.
P3 and P4 walk through gate A and stand on the plate at x=28-29: gate E upstairs (x=24) opens.
P1 and P2 walk through gate E, hop the 2-high bump at x=32-33; P1 touches the key at x=36; both drop through the hole at x=38-40 into the lower corridor.
P3 and P4 step off their plate; everyone walks to the door at x=43; P1 opens it; all press Down.
